name: discord
description: Legacy Discord webhook/bot tool. Prefer the discord-channel skill (Tools → Discord) for scoped two-way messaging.

manual.overview: Use Discord when sending alerts, bot messages, or notifications to Discord servers. Webhooks are simplest for one-way posting; bot mode offers more control when configured.

examples.description: Override webhook URL and mention everyone
Send via bot to a specific channel

tips: Webhooks are easiest; create one in Discord channel settings and set NLS_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL
Discord content is plain text; use Markdown for *bold*, _italic_, and `code`
Message length limit is 2000 characters; truncate or split long content
For send_bot, ensure the bot has Send Messages permission in the channel
edge_cases: Invalid or expired webhook URLs return 404; verify the URL is correct and not revoked
Discord rate limits aggressively; avoid sending many messages in quick succession
Empty or whitespace-only content may be rejected; ensure content has actual text
